criteria.criterion: npm run typecheck runs tsc --noEmit on the full project
criteria.evidence: npm run typecheck completes with no errors

criteria.criterion: A staged TS file with a type error blocks the commit
criteria.evidence: lint-staged configured to run tsc --noEmit; pre-commit hook runs npx lint-staged which exits non-zero on failure

criteria.criterion: A staged TSX file with ESLint violation blocks the commit
criteria.evidence: lint-staged configured to run eslint --fix on *.tsx; eslint exits non-zero on unfixable errors

criteria.criterion: Non-TS files staged allow commit to proceed
criteria.evidence: lint-staged glob only matches *.ts,tsx,mts; other file types are skipped

criteria.criterion: git commit succeeds when all checks pass
criteria.evidence: npm run typecheck passes clean; pre-commit hook calls lint-staged which runs eslint and tsc

criteria.criterion: npm install in fresh clone initializes hooks
criteria.evidence: prepare script configures git core.hooksPath and chmods pre-commit hook

additional_issues.description: tsc --noEmit in lint-staged checks the full project, not just staged files (known tsc limitation documented in spec)
additional_issues.fix_needed: No fix needed — documented as acceptable tradeoff in the spec
